title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases of Judicial Compensation in Civil and Administrative Litigation

articles.content_en: Article 1 Where a People's Court, in the process of a civil action or administrative action, illegally takes compulsory measures, preservation measures, or advance execution measures against obstruction of litigation, or commits errors in enforcing judgments, rulings, or other effective legal instruments, thereby infringing upon the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, or other organizations and causing damage, the claimant for compensation may apply to the People's Court for compensation according to law.

Article 6 Where a functionary of a People's Court, in the process of a civil action or administrative action, commits acts such as beating, maltreating, or instigating or indulging others to beat or maltreat, or illegally uses weapons or police equipment, causing physical injury or death to a citizen, compensation shall be granted in accordance with the provisions of Items (4) and (5) of Article 17 of the State Compensation Law.

Article 8 Where damage to the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, or other organizations is caused by multiple reasons, the amount of compensation shall be reasonably determined based on factors such as the role played by the act of exercising functions by the People's Court and its functionaries in the occurrence or aggravation of the damage.

Article 9 Where the victim is also at fault for the occurrence or aggravation of the damage, the State compensation liability shall be mitigated according to law based on factors such as the role played by the victim's fault in the occurrence or aggravation of the damage.

Article 10 Where losses of citizens, legal persons, or other organizations have already been compensated or indemnified during the civil action or administrative action, the State shall not bear compensation liability for such losses.

Article 11 Where a People's Court or its functionaries, in the process of a civil action or administrative action, are in the circumstances specified in Article 2 or Article 6 of this Interpretation, and infringe upon the personal rights of a citizen, the compensation amount shall be calculated in accordance with Articles 33 and 34 of the State Compensation Law. If mental damage is caused, the victim shall have his or her negative impact eliminated, reputation rehabilitated, and an apology made within the scope affected by the infringing act in accordance with Article 35 of the State Compensation Law; if serious consequences are caused, corresponding compensation for mental damage shall also be paid.

Article 12 Where a People's Court or its functionaries, in the process of a civil action or administrative action, are in the circumstances specified in Articles 2 through 5 of this Interpretation, and infringe upon the property rights of citizens, legal persons, or other organizations and cause damage, they shall bear compensation liability in accordance with Article 36 of the State Compensation Law.
If the property cannot be restored to its original state or is lost, the loss shall be calculated based on the market price at the time of the infringing act; if the market price cannot be determined or such price is insufficient to compensate for the victim's loss, other reasonable methods may be used to calculate the loss.

Article 13 Where a People's Court or its functionaries commit errors in enforcing judgments, rulings, or other effective legal instruments, and have already auctioned or sold by private sale the property of a citizen, legal person, or other organization in accordance with statutory procedures, the proceeds from the auction or private sale shall be paid.
If the People's Court conducted an illegal auction, or the proceeds from the private sale are obviously lower than the property value, corresponding compensation shall be paid in accordance with Article 12 of this Interpretation.

Article 14 The necessary recurrent expenses during the period of suspension of production and business operations as specified in Item (6) of Article 36 of the State Compensation Law refer to the basic expenses required by legal persons, other organizations, and individual industrial and commercial households to maintain operations during the suspension period, including the wages of retained employees, mandatory taxes and fees, water and electricity charges, rent for premises and sites, equipment rent, equipment depreciation, and other necessary recurrent expenses.

Article 15 The interest on bank deposits for the same period as specified in Item (7) of Article 36 of the State Compensation Law shall be calculated based on the benchmark interest rate for one-year lump-sum deposit of RMB published by the People's Bank of China at the time when the effective compensation decision is made, without compound interest.
If the property to be returned is a lawful deposit in a financial institution, the interest during the period of the deposit contract shall be calculated at the agreed interest rate in the contract.
If the property to be returned is cash, interest shall be paid by analogy to the provisions of Paragraph 1 of this Article.

Article 16 Where the property to be returned in accordance with Article 36 of the State Compensation Law is a loan from a financial institution approved by the State, in addition to the principal of the loan, the loan interest under the loan borrowing status shall also be paid.

Article 17 Where a usufruct holder, security interest holder, lessee, or other person who lawfully possesses or uses property applies for compensation in accordance with Article 38 of the State Compensation Law, the People's Court shall review and file the case in accordance with the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Filing of State Compensation Cases.

Article 18 Where the People's Court, in the process of a civil action or administrative action, illegally takes compulsory measures, preservation measures, or advance execution measures, or commits errors in enforcing judgments, rulings, or other effective legal instruments, and such acts are caused by the reconsideration decision of the People's Court at the next higher level altering the original ruling, the People's Court at the next higher level shall be the compensatory obligor.

Article 21 When trying a judicial compensation case in a civil action or administrative action, the Compensation Committee of the People's Court shall review together the following matters: whether the act of exercising functions by the People's Court and its functionaries complies with legal provisions, whether the damage facts claimed by the claimant for compensation exist, and whether there is a causal relationship between the act of exercising functions and the damage facts.

Article 22 This Interpretation shall come into force as of October 1, 2016. Where any judicial interpretation issued by the Supreme People's Court before the coming into force of this Interpretation is inconsistent with this Interpretation, this Interpretation shall prevail.
